segments.source: Fern–Harbor–Elm has segment costs [8, 9] (total 17); Fern–Oak–Dover–Elm has segment costs [7, 6, 4] (total 17); Fern–Iris–Elm has segment costs [11, 6] (total 17).
segments.translation: Fern–Harbor–Elm are costurile segmentelor [8, 9] (total 17); Fern–Oak–Dover–Elm are costurile segmentelor [7, 6, 4] (total 17); Fern–Iris–Elm are costurile segmentelor [11, 6] (total 17).

segments.source: Rules.
segments.translation: Reguli.

segments.source: A route is feasible only if all of its roads are open. The cost of a route is the sum of its segment costs. Choose the feasible route with the smallest total.
segments.translation: Un traseu este posibil doar dacă toate drumurile lui sunt deschise. Costul unui traseu este suma costurilor segmentelor sale. Alege traseul posibil cu cel mai mic total.

segments.source: Task.
segments.translation: Sarcină.

segments.source: Which route should a traveler use from Fern to Elm, and why?
segments.translation: Ce traseu ar trebui să folosească un călător de la Fern la Elm și de ce?

segments.source: Step-by-step solution.
segments.translation: Rezolvare pas cu pas.

segments.source: 1. List the candidate routes and their segment costs. 2. All listed routes are open. 3. Add the segment costs for every feasible route. 4. The smallest feasible total is 17, on Fern–Harbor–Elm.
segments.translation: 1. Enumeră traseele candidate și costurile segmentelor lor. 2. Toate traseele enumerate sunt deschise. 3. Adună costurile segmentelor pentru fiecare traseu posibil. 4. Cel mai mic total posibil este 17, pe Fern–Harbor–Elm.

segments.source: Answer.
segments.translation: Răspuns.

segments.source: Use Fern–Harbor–Elm; total cost 17.
segments.translation: Folosește Fern–Harbor–Elm; cost total 17.

segments.source: Knowledge takeaway.
segments.translation: Ce am învățat.

segments.source: A shortest path is a reasoning result: first respect constraints, then compare the remaining costs.
segments.translation: Drumul cel mai scurt este rezultatul unui raționament: mai întâi respecți constrângerile, apoi compari costurile rămase.

segments.source: Formal model.
segments.translation: Model formal.

segments.source: Weighted graph; delete forbidden edges; minimize the sum of edge weights.
segments.translation: Graf ponderat; elimină muchiile interzise; minimizează suma ponderilor muchiilor.

segments.source: G3. Rivers: upstream and downstream
segments.translation: G3. Râuri: amonte și aval

segments.source: Problem 261. Following water from North Fork
segments.translation: Problema 261. Urmărind apa din North Fork

segments.source: Knowledge context.
segments.translation: Context de cunoaștere.

segments.source: River systems form directed networks: water has a direction, tributaries join larger streams, and upstream/downstream are relational concepts.
segments.translation: Sistemele de râuri formează rețele orientate: apa are o direcție, afluenții se varsă în cursuri mai mari, iar amonte/aval sunt concepte relaționale.

segments.source: Given facts.
segments.translation: Fapte date.

segments.source: North Fork flows into Willow Stream; Blue Creek flows into Willow Stream; Willow Stream flows into Clearwater.
segments.translation: North Fork se varsă în Willow Stream; Blue Creek se varsă în Willow Stream; Willow Stream se varsă în Clearwater.

segments.source: Rules.
segments.translation: Reguli.

segments.source: If river X flows into river Y, X is upstream of Y. Upstream relations can be followed through several confluences. Downstream is the reverse direction of flow.
segments.translation: Dacă râul X se varsă în râul Y, X este în amonte de Y. Relațiile de amonte pot fi urmărite prin mai multe confluențe. Avalul este direcția inversă a curgerii.

segments.source: Task.
segments.translation: Sarcină.

segments.source: Is North Fork upstream of Clearwater? Can water from North Fork reach Clearwater through the stated network?
segments.translation: Este North Fork în amonte de Clearwater? Poate apa din North Fork să ajungă la Clearwater prin rețeaua enunțată?

segments.source: Step-by-step solution.
segments.translation: Rezolvare pas cu pas.

segments.source: 1. Rewrite the facts as arrows: North Fork→Willow Stream, Blue Creek→Willow Stream, Willow Stream→Clearwater. 2. Follow arrows starting from North Fork. 3. An arrow path reaches Clearwater, so North Fork is upstream of Clearwater.
segments.translation: 1. Rescrie faptele ca săgeți: North Fork→Willow Stream, Blue Creek→Willow Stream, Willow Stream→Clearwater. 2. Urmează săgețile pornind din North Fork. 3. Un drum de săgeți ajunge la Clearwater, deci North Fork este în amonte de Clearwater.

segments.source: Answer.
segments.translation: Răspuns.

segments.source: Yes; water from North Fork can reach Clearwater.
segments.translation: Da; apa din North Fork poate ajunge la Clearwater.

segments.source: Knowledge takeaway.
segments.translation: Ce am învățat.

segments.source: A river network can be reasoned about like any directed network; following the arrows is more reliable than guessing from names.
segments.translation: Despre o rețea de râuri se poate raționa ca despre orice rețea orientată; urmărirea săgeților este mai sigură decât ghicitul după nume.

segments.source: Formal model.
segments.translation: Model formal.

segments.source: Directed graph; edge X→Y means water can flow from X to Y; query reachability.
segments.translation: Graf orientat; muchia X→Y înseamnă că apa poate curge de la X la Y; se verifică accesibilitatea.
